messages.content: Hey, weekly check-in from Northline Care. How's everything going this week — any readings to share, or anything on your mind?

BP's been around 138/82 most days. Bigger issue is I'm almost out of lisinopril and my doctor said I need an actual new prescription this time, not just a refill. Pharmacy's a 45-minute drive one way.

Thanks — logging that reading. And noted on the lisinopril. Just to be upfront: I can't handle prescriptions, refills, or pharmacy logistics. But needing a new script when you're close to running out is exactly the kind of thing our nursing team needs to know about, so I'm flagging this for them now.
Okay. How long before someone gets back to me? I've got maybe 4 days left.

I just escalated to a nurse. Median response time right now is 31 hours, so you should hear from someone with plenty of time to spare before you run out. They'll be able to coordinate with your prescriber on next steps.
Of course. I'll set your next check-in for next week. If anything changes before then — readings, symptoms, anything — just text back.

theme: prescription refill needs a new script, pharmacy is far away
